# LegatorOCR 0.2.0-pre.67

No change in behaviour; this release cleans the repository after an adversarial comparison with the open-source and commercial tools.

- **Files with unclear rights were removed from the tree**: the two unused candidate OCR models (`candidate-books.lnm`, `candidate-digital.lnm`, trained on PDFs of third parties and never part of a build) and five hand transcriptions of pages of a 1960 textbook. They stay in the git history. The scripts that used the transcriptions remain as method only.
- `COMPARISON.md` section 2 now shows the current accuracy figures with their caveats (the native engine's lead comes from fine-tuning on the same magazine; no hand-verified reference set exists), replacing an outdated table.
- `docs/audit/competitors.md`, `docs/ADVERSARIAL-ANALYSIS.md`, `docs/clean-room/PROVENANCE.md` and `docs/audit/assets-licences.md` were brought up to date (what was re-read on 17 Nov, what is still open).

Still open and not fixable from code: the rights to the magazine issues and the 1960 manual used to fine-tune the built-in model `multi.lnm`; written agreement with the co-author; a similarity scan against ScanTailor; a legal opinion. See `docs/clean-room/PROVENANCE.md`.
